_about: The release's preview settings (merge/prod-2 @ 51f4d243: 1 part / 1 MiB per append, 4 appends in flight to the end; 1 MiB reads, 2 in flight; the server advertises the limits), as the cost calculator reads them: build-data.mjs --proxy-release. Transcribed from the sources named in each section; the numbers are theirs. The final runs' CPU distribution and 4G speeds come from cf-verify4's verified.json (--proxy-final), not from here.
